title: Desktop spec red: shell-window-no-late-resize dies on its first main-process evaluate
description: tests/desktop/shell-window-no-late-resize.spec.js (MPI-1230) fails every run on master: electronApplication.evaluate 'Execution context was destroyed' at its first app.evaluate right after electron.launch. Only red in the desktop suite (251/252). Find why the main-process context goes away and fix app or spec.
